# #3698: Patch: a replay names the opponent as its row in the replays list does
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means
The replays list says "Win · vs Bob", but the replay it opens calls Bob only "Opponent", and a practice game's replay says "Opponent" though the live game said "AI · Easy". Once this is built, a replay labels the other side as the list and the live game did: the opponent's name for an online game, the AI and its level for practice.

## Why
- The online row names the opponent (`apps/web/src/routes/replays.tsx:451-455`; "a deleted account" when the name is gone).
- `ReplayPlayerProps` (`apps/web/src/replay/ReplayPlayer.tsx:33-43`) takes no label, so the opened board falls back to `Hero`'s default "Opponent" (`apps/web/src/game/Hero.tsx:210`), and the modifier list is handed "Opponent" (`ReplayPlayer.tsx:281`).
- The live practice board passes its label through `Game`'s `enemyLabel` (`apps/web/src/routes/practice.tsx:1081`, `:1116`); the replay of the same game drops it.
- The owner already wanted known seats named: a watched game and a friend's shared replay speak of the friend by name (#2019).

## Proposal
`ReplayPlayer` takes an optional `opponentLabel`, passed to `Game`'s `enemyLabel` and to `ModifierList`. Each caller fills it from what it already holds: the replays list from the row's opponent (the AI and its tier for a practice row), the practice result's replay from the live board's label, a match result's replay from the name the match screen already shows. A friend's shared-replay route keeps its own wording. A long name is cut with an ellipsis in `.hero-seat`. The shared GIF is unchanged, since it names no seat (R513000). Presentation only (CLAUDE.md rule 7).

## Where it lands
- `apps/web/src/replay/ReplayPlayer.tsx`, `apps/web/src/routes/replays.tsx`, `apps/web/src/routes/practice.tsx`, `apps/web/src/routes/match.tsx`, `apps/web/src/game/board.css`
- `apps/web/src/replay/ReplayPlayer.test.tsx`, `apps/web/src/routes/replays.test.tsx`, `apps/web/src/i18n/zh-CN.json` for any new string
- SPEC §9.5; R513000

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `ReplayPlayer` given `opponentLabel` "Bob#12" shows it on the opponent hero's seat label and in the modifier list; without it, "Opponent" as today.
- [ ] Opening an online row from the replays list labels the opponent with its username, "a deleted account" when it is empty; a practice row shows the AI's label.
- [ ] A practice game's replay shows the live board's label.
- [ ] A friend's shared replay and the shared GIF are unchanged.

## Size and risks
Small to medium: about five files and their tests. A replay opened from a link with no list row behind it has no name to show and keeps "Opponent".
